comparison.objective: Back-drive a capper starwheel in the safe direction to release and reject a jammed bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Infer rotation direction, apply controlled torque to a mechanism, then extract and place the bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel first turned at least 6 degrees backward; premature bottle motion or 3-degree forward rotation permanently fails; bottle must finish upright in the bin.
comparison.reason: Both involve safe manipulation of industrial mechanisms, but this record tests directional jam release and extraction rather than precision damper commissioning and response-based tuning.
